summary: OSpec 1.8.11 keeps a real partially repaired Goal moving without weakening its no-progress guard. Task and grouped final repair can now continue past the convergence threshold when a stable finding ID materially narrows and the code snapshot inside the prior authorized repair scope also changed. Wording-only changes, code-only churn, exact repeats, cycles, and unprovable legacy history still stop.
new: Added review dispatch, full target snapshot, and authorized repair-scope snapshot provenance to new task repair contexts and grouped final repair waves.
Added findings_refined and reviewed_target_unchanged convergence diagnostics.
improved: Lets reviewers keep a stable finding ID while a real repair narrows the same root defect, without requiring manual repair-limit increases.
Recovers missing 1.8.9 and 1.8.10 repair snapshot fields from the latest valid completed review dispatch before the repair was created.
fixed: Fixed task repair stopping as findings_unchanged when both implementation code and the remaining structured finding had materially converged under the same ID.
Fixed grouped final repair using the same ID-only convergence comparison.
Preserved no-progress protection for wording-only changes, code-only churn, exact repeats, finding cycles, and invalid or missing provenance.
docs: Documented the confirmed same-ID task repair incident, dual-evidence convergence contract, legacy artifact recovery, controller behavior, and unchanged safety gates.
